newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon wins Dutch refinery contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon wins Dutch refinery contract.

text.p: Raytheon Co said on Thursday it has been awarded a $24 million contract for a restructuring project at the Netherlands Refining Company BV (Nerefco) refinery in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.
Nerefco is a joint venture of British Petroleum Co Plc and Texaco Inc that currently operates two refineries in the Rotterdam area, Raytheon said.
This restructuring project, which costs $150 million in total, aims to improve operating margins by converting to a single-site operation at Europoort, Raytheon said.

The project will be performed under an alliance agreement among Nerefco, Fabricom, NBM-Amstelland NV, and Raytheon, the company said. The project is scheduled for completion by the fourth quarter of 1998, Raytheon said.
Raytheon said it will provide engineering, procurement, and construction management services within the integrated project team formed by the alliance companies.
